Cryptography

Khóa riêng

A confidential cryptographic key in an asymmetric key pair, used to sign or decrypt data, and must be kept secret to maintain security.

Definition

A confidential cryptographic key in an asymmetric key pair, used to sign or decrypt data, and must be kept secret to maintain security.

Operational example

If a private key is compromised, all certificates or signatures generated with it should be considered invalid and revoked.
